$comment: Since SDK 2.6.0 (ARCHITECTURE.md ADR-5.4): a `text` message may carry `locale`, the language its wording is for. The chat keeps one set per language and shows the set for the language it is in; a `text` without `locale` is for the app's language, as before 2.6.0, and is shown when no set matches. An SDK keeps every set it was given (one per locale, the locale-less one included) and sends them all again on each `ready`.

kept.$comment: What an SDK holds after the three messages above, keyed by locale ("" for none), and resends on `ready`.

rejected.$comment: `locale` is a BCP 47 tag; a message with anything else is rejected whole.
